title: Prove graders and the perf-ci gate both ways
description: Every grader fails a known-bad answer and passes a known-good one; grader mutations turn the predicted cases red; the perf-ci gate fails on an injected regression and passes a clean change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each grader has a recorded known-good and known-bad result
Mutating a separable grader assertion turns the predicted subset red
The perf-ci gate is shown failing on an injected regression and passing a clean change

finalSummary: Graders proven both ways: 19 variants, 171/171 cells, 18/18 mutations (evals/results/round1-proofs/graders-proof.json); perf-ci gate proven both ways (ci-gate-proof.json). Delivered in feat/PSKI-14-release-v0.1.0; no checks configured.
